This page examines the James Bond films in the dataset.

::: {#0bf21299 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide revenue (millions of US dollars)")
plt.show()
```
